title: cyperus praealtus
intro: Cyperus praealtus, commonly known as the high papyrus, is a species of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus praealtus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Furthermore, the plant is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections, due to its expectorant and antimicrobial properties.
